meta.name: Generate monthly PDF lead reports from Monday.com with Gemini and Gmail

name: [INTERN - Aaron] Monday to brief report template

parameters.content:
## Monthly Monday.com to PDF Report Automation

This workflow automatically turns your Monday.com board data into a polished, print-ready PDF report and emails it to your team every month — powered by an AI layout engine and an HTML-to-PDF service.

## Who’s it for?
For sales, operations, and leadership teams who track leads and deals in Monday.com and want a recurring, professionally formatted performance report without any manual work.

## How it works
1. A Schedule Trigger fires once a month and pulls all items from the configured Monday.com board.
2. The `Transform Data` node flattens each item’s column values into clean rows matching the report schema.
3. The rows are aggregated into a single dataset and handed to the AI Agent.
4. The AI Agent (Gemini via OpenRouter) renders a fully-styled HTML report and converts it to a PDF, returning a download link.
5. The PDF is downloaded and emailed to the team via Gmail, with the report link included in the message body.

## How to set up
- Connect your Monday.com credentials in the `Get Leads` node and set the correct `Board ID` and `Group`.
- Confirm the column names in `Transform Data` match your board columns exactly.
- Connect OpenRouter (Gemini model) and the HTML-to-PDF (PDFMunk) API credentials on the AI Agent sub-nodes.
- Set the recipient address and subject in the `Send Report` (Gmail) node.
- Adjust the Schedule Trigger cadence if you need a different interval.
- Activate the workflow to run automatically each month.

## 1. Schedule & Fetch Monday.com Data

The Schedule Trigger runs once a month and kicks off the report. `Get Leads` retrieves all board items (leads/deals) from the configured Monday.com board and group.

## 2. Transform & Aggregate

`Transform Data` maps each Monday.com item’s column values into a flat row (Name, Date, Status, Owner, Email, Phone, Location, Files). `Aggregate Data` then combines all rows into a single dataset to feed the AI Agent in one pass.

## 3. Generate the PDF Report

The AI Agent (Gemini via OpenRouter) renders the aggregated data into a fully-styled, print-ready HTML document, then uses the HTML-to-PDF tool to produce the PDF. The Structured Output Parser returns the generated report link.

## 4. Download & Email the Report

`Download File` downloads the generated PDF from the report link. `Send Report` (Gmail) then emails the PDF as an attachment to the team, including the report link in the message body.
